reviewer_concerns: AE-C2: lack of comparison with state-of-the-art work on the same problem
R3-C2: no comparison against a closely related contemporary repair method
claim_boundary: This is a controlled comparison with one runnable contemporary coding agent, not a claim that it is the unique state of the art.

model_change_record.decision: Use gpt-5.6-luna for both conditions in the formal ten-project run.
model_change_record.comparability_rule: Do not pool the earlier gpt-5.6-sol pilot with the formal gpt-5.6-luna results.

formal_run.failed_run_note: formal_01 stopped because container-owned files prevented rollback. formal_02 stopped on a synthetic HomeCheck path absent from an API-8 project. formal_03 accepted package-exported signature changes before an API guard existed. formal_04 showed two harness problems: narrated, unfenced source responses and missing evaluator rejection feedback. formal_05 fixed those problems but incorrectly treated ArkTS checker diagnostics such as arkts-no-any-unknown as fatal instead of enabling the compiler-supported ignoreWarning mode. formal_06 applies the same ignoreWarning build policy to both conditions and still requires the complete Hvigor build and packaging process to exit successfully. No earlier formal run is pooled.
formal_run.order_basis: Ascending frozen initial alert count; within-project condition order alternates by project rank. The order was fixed before the formal run.

dataset.stratification: 2 x 2 by median source LOC and median initial alert density
dataset.selection_timing: before either repair condition is run
dataset.version_policy: Each recovered upstream repository is pinned by commit; both conditions start from byte-identical copies of the selected project tree.

common_input: same HomeCheck file, line, column, rule, severity, and message
same maximum of five post-edit HomeCheck validation runs

read_only_mounts: HomeCheck rule documentation and checker implementation
agent_runtime.network_policy: Container networking is required for the model API; the agent prompt forbids network-based project or repair lookup.

validation.arkts_diagnostic_policy: Both conditions enable the ArkTS compiler's ignoreWarning mode. ArkTS checker diagnostics do not stop compilation; later compiler, module-resolution, packaging, timeout, and process failures remain fatal.

arkts_diagnostic_verification.observed_boundary: The old RAG output continued past its prior ArkTS checker diagnostics and then failed on unresolved OhmUrl imports, which remain fatal.

build_preflight.round_rejection_rule: When the frozen evaluator build fails, restore the pre-round editable-file snapshot and verify the rollback build before HomeCheck validation.
build_preflight.test_gate: No selected project exposes a passing evaluator-side host test task; all projects retain the statically validated only claim boundary.

alert_metrics.identity: multiset over (relative_path, rule, normalized message); line and column are retained for localization but excluded from cross-version matching so unrelated line shifts do not create false elimination/introduction pairs
